results.title: Winter Malaiyo
results.description: A frothy, airy milk dessert that is only available in winter mornings. It disappears in the heat!
results.how_to_find: Thatheri Bazar, Chowk area. Look for large cauldrons of yellow foam.

results.title: The Ancient Lolark Kund
results.description: An ancient stepwell dedicated to the Sun God, hidden near Tulsi Ghat. It's said to be older than the rest of the city.
results.how_to_find: Walk south past Assi Ghat towards Tulsi Ghat. Ask locals for the 'Kund'. It is down a narrow lane.
